note: Review manifest; canonical risk-knowledge-v1.json remains source of truth. All replacements are candidate language, not validated control outcomes.

required_evidence_replacements.100: Emergency kill-switch and containment configuration covering agent, tool, credential, provider and destination shutdown plus outstanding-work cancellation.
required_evidence_replacements.101: Versioned AI-specific incident response policy and tabletop records covering detection, triage, containment, evidence custody, provider coordination and recovery.
required_evidence_replacements.102: Credential, session, approval, MCP/tool and workload-identity revocation configuration specifying propagation, expiry and emergency containment.
required_evidence_replacements.103: Backup inventory and recovery policy for model configuration, vector stores, agent memory, evidence and approval records, including integrity and encryption.
required_evidence_replacements.104: Release provenance, rollback procedure and immutable deployment-artifact records covering authorized rollback, data compatibility and staged recovery.
required_evidence_replacements.105: Finding tracking and closure policy including named owner, due date, severity rationale, remediation task, evidence requirements and approval roles.
required_evidence_replacements.106: Remediation and adversarial retest plan linking each confirmed finding to the exact changed version, original failure path and regression/bypass cases.
required_evidence_replacements.107: Deployment evidence-chain policy linking the exact assessed version, control applicability, reviewer signoffs, residual risk and final accountable decision.
required_evidence_replacements.108: Post-deployment reassessment policy covering evidence expiry, model/tool changes, incidents, drift, scheduled reviews and decision-owner notification.
required_evidence_replacements.015: Versioned memory/vector-store inventory, namespace and tenant bindings, read/write principals, backup copies, retention and deletion paths, with linked source or configuration evidence.
required_evidence_replacements.016: Exact model-provider and deployed-model inventory with immutable model revision or digest, prompt/configuration revision, inference settings and documented drift-triggered reassessment evidence.
required_evidence_replacements.017: Exact-build software and AI dependency inventory or SBOM with package and model versions, lockfiles, registry provenance, container digest references and links to deployed artefacts.
required_evidence_replacements.018: Environment-by-environment configuration inventory for accounts, credentials, networks, queues, data stores and tool endpoints, identifying prohibited cross-environment routes.
required_evidence_replacements.019: Server-side authentication middleware and route configuration for each sensitive operation, including identity-provider failure behaviour and credential/session verification policy.
required_evidence_replacements.033: Versioned agent goal and task-scope definition with per-step policy or planner configuration showing where deviations are detected, stopped or explicitly escalated.
required_evidence_replacements.034: System-prompt confidentiality policy and output/logging configuration identifying protected prompt material, permitted disclosure and redaction boundaries.
required_evidence_replacements.035: Message assembly and instruction-precedence source or configuration evidence identifying system, developer, user, retrieved and tool-originated content trust levels.
required_evidence_replacements.036: File, message and browser-input parser and authorization configuration distinguishing untrusted extracted content from authenticated tool or action commands.
required_evidence_replacements.037: Input decoding, Unicode canonicalisation and policy-evaluation source or configuration evidence showing the normalization order before security checks.
required_evidence_replacements.038: Multimodal ingestion and extraction configuration covering OCR, embedded metadata, audio, video and image-to-text trust boundaries and downstream tool permissions.
required_evidence_replacements.039: Dynamic prompt-template construction, escaping and structured-message configuration identifying interpolated fields and role or delimiter injection boundaries.
required_evidence_replacements.040: Long-context assembly and truncation configuration identifying safety-control placement, instruction precedence and review of omitted or low-salience content.
required_evidence_replacements.041: Versioned model-payload schema and preprocessing or redaction configuration mapping each transmitted sensitive field to a documented processing purpose.
required_evidence_replacements.042: Data intake, user-notice and processing-purpose inventory linked to collection, logging, feature use, storage and retention configuration for each personal-data field.
required_evidence_replacements.043: Retrieval identity propagation, tenant-scoping and document authorization configuration linked to index namespaces, prefilter rules and source-level ACL enforcement.
required_evidence_replacements.044: Knowledge ingestion source provenance, signer or publisher trust, write permissions, approval and index-version configuration for reviewed source documents.
required_evidence_replacements.045: Vector-service endpoint, namespace and metadata-filter configuration linked to access principals, isolation policies and privacy-preserving query controls.
required_evidence_replacements.046: Persistent-memory write and approval configuration including authorized identities, stored claim provenance, promotion criteria and correction or deletion routes.
required_evidence_replacements.047: Memory/cache invalidation, source-version binding and precedence configuration identifying expiry, supersession and removal of stale stored facts.
required_evidence_replacements.048: Retention/deletion inventory and implementation configuration for primary records, vectors, embeddings, caches, logs, backups and derived AI artefacts.
required_evidence_replacements.049: Response serialization, output filtering and authorization configuration that identifies confidential-data exposure checks across direct and transformed outputs.
required_evidence_replacements.050: Training and fine-tuning dataset lineage and privacy-control records linked to record minimisation, cohort restrictions and memorisation-test design.
required_evidence_replacements.051: Answer-to-source provenance design including passage-level citations, source identifiers, content digests, freshness and access-control verification.
required_evidence_replacements.052: Aggregate-query access policy and disclosure-control configuration including minimum cohort sizes, query budgets and protections against overlapping-query inference.
required_evidence_replacements.053: Versioned tool capability and credential-scope inventory tied to approved tasks, principal identities, available operations and least-privilege configuration.
required_evidence_replacements.054: Runtime tool catalogue and allowlist configuration tied to tool identity, environment, publisher and binding rules for unrecognised or cross-environment tools.
required_evidence_replacements.055: Independent tool-argument schema and server-side authorization validation configuration for missing, malformed, out-of-range and cross-tenant parameter values.
required_evidence_replacements.056: Tool-command construction and interpreter boundary source evidence identifying escaped arguments, parameterization, process privileges and prohibited dynamic execution sinks.
required_evidence_replacements.057: Relevant source, proxy, DNS, firewall, allowlist or tool configuration showing outbound destination validation, redirect rechecks and isolation of private or metadata addresses.
required_evidence_replacements.058: File-tool root-path, filesystem authorization and path-resolution configuration showing containment of traversal, symlinks, archives and race-sensitive operations.
required_evidence_replacements.059: Code-execution sandbox configuration for filesystem, process, network, secret, resource and persistence containment, including container/runtime escape boundaries.
required_evidence_replacements.060: MCP server publisher, package digest, transport identity, deployment version, tool-schema catalogue and signed-change provenance records.
required_evidence_replacements.061: Tool-result ingestion and prompt-construction configuration distinguishing untrusted tool output from privileged instructions or future tool authorizations.
required_evidence_replacements.062: MCP/tool namespace registry and immutable tool-identity configuration documenting publisher qualification, schema collision detection and explicit selection.
required_evidence_replacements.063: Idempotency-key issuance, side-effect deduplication, retry and transaction/locking configuration covering concurrent and replayed tool operations.
required_evidence_replacements.064: Inter-agent message authentication and authorization configuration covering sender identity, audience, tenant boundary, replay protection and delegated authority.
required_evidence_replacements.065: Server-side approval enforcement configuration demonstrating that caller-supplied flags and free-text approver names have no decision authority.
required_evidence_replacements.066: Canonical action-digest and approval binding schema covering tool, target, environment, amount, arguments, recipient, actor and expiry.
required_evidence_replacements.067: One-time approval-token storage, expiry, revocation and atomic consumption configuration protecting against sequential and concurrent replay.
required_evidence_replacements.068: Approver authentication, role validation and signed approval-event configuration linking decisions to verified principals rather than request fields.
required_evidence_replacements.069: Separation-of-duties and approver-assignment configuration demonstrating distinct requester and approver principals and independent role authority.
required_evidence_replacements.070: Approval freshness and invalidation configuration covering identity revocation, role changes, policy revisions and material action-scope changes.
required_evidence_replacements.071: High-value transaction threshold, aggregation and multi-approver policy configuration covering split transactions, dual control and override approvals.
required_evidence_replacements.072: Approval display schema and canonical action payload mapping showing amounts, recipients, privileges, side effects and ambiguity-safe formatting.
required_evidence_replacements.073: Model provider and publisher provenance records with immutable model version/digest, signatures where available, license/source and distribution-channel identity.
required_evidence_replacements.074: Model loader allowlist and accepted file-format configuration identifying executable deserialization risks, sandbox limits and artifact signature checks.
required_evidence_replacements.075: Container build-and-deploy manifest recording immutable image digests, registry signatures, source revision and the exact running image identity.
required_evidence_replacements.076: Dependency and version inventory correlated with applicable security advisories and reachability or exploitability review for the assessed deployed release.
required_evidence_replacements.077: Plugin, package and MCP dependency provenance records including publisher identity, manifest integrity, installation scripts, permissions and update channels.
required_evidence_replacements.078: Version-bound model regression and drift test plan covering comparable input corpora, policy settings, output metrics and approval-triggering thresholds.
required_evidence_replacements.079: Training/fine-tuning dataset provenance and ingestion policy covering contributor permissions, integrity checks, suspicious samples and curation approval.
required_evidence_replacements.080: Provider fallback policy and configuration covering alternate model identity, processing region, retention, permissions, tool access and downgrade approval.
required_evidence_replacements.081: Model-output parsing and sink validation configuration identifying where generated text becomes executable code, data-store queries or privileged actions.
required_evidence_replacements.082: Generated-content rendering and HTML sanitisation configuration covering text/attribute/URL contexts, trusted types and stored or reflected XSS sinks.
required_evidence_replacements.083: Data-store query construction and parameterization configuration for generated model values, filter operators, identifiers and tenant-scoped access controls.
required_evidence_replacements.084: Generated email, HTTP header, log and structured-protocol serialization configuration covering CRLF, delimiters and control-character escaping.
required_evidence_replacements.085: Generated document and export pipeline configuration specifying allowed MIME types, macro/formula protections, embedded links and content scanning.
required_evidence_replacements.086: Consequential-decision use-case specification, reference-source policy and human escalation configuration for unsupported or out-of-domain model answers.
required_evidence_replacements.087: Runtime security-policy decision-point configuration mapping each sensitive request and tool operation to externally enforced checks before effects.
required_evidence_replacements.088: Policy-engine error, timeout and dependency-failure handling configuration showing default-deny behaviour, stale-policy handling and auditability.
required_evidence_replacements.089: Logging, tracing and export redaction configuration specifying permitted prompt, credential, personal-data and error-field handling.
required_evidence_replacements.090: Audit-event schema and correlation configuration linking actor, canonical request, policy version, approvals, tool effects, timestamps and immutable evidence IDs.
required_evidence_replacements.091: Audit-evidence storage and integrity configuration covering append-only logging, signature or hash chaining, immutable checkpoints and privileged alteration alerts.
required_evidence_replacements.092: Alert routing and escalation policy with on-call owner assignments, synthetic-drill records, delivery tracking and response time objectives.
required_evidence_replacements.093: Abuse/anomaly detection configuration covering credential misuse, unusual tool sequences, bulk access, destination changes and alert ownership.
required_evidence_replacements.094: Telemetry inventory with event-field purpose, redaction, access authorization, storage destination, retention period and deletion configuration.
required_evidence_replacements.095: Per-principal token, compute, concurrency and tool-use budget configuration covering denial, cancellation, retries and cumulative resource accounting.
required_evidence_replacements.096: Planner and delegated-agent recursion limits, step budgets, timeout and cycle-detection configuration defining enforced termination and containment.
required_evidence_replacements.097: Third-party dependency failure and fallback configuration covering timeouts, retry bounds, circuit breakers, data handling and degraded-mode permissions.
required_evidence_replacements.098: Concurrent state mutation and transaction configuration specifying locks, isolation levels, atomic approvals, quota reservation and rollback semantics.
required_evidence_replacements.099: Metering and billing authorization configuration covering key rotation, identity aliases, concurrent counters, retries, thresholds and tamper resistance.
